notes:
I couldn't write these notes because none of my research went through. When I tried to open the sources (Enduring Word on Ezekiel 20, the Bible Hub commentary pages for vv. 25–49 with Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary, and Precept Austin), the tool said I had no more calls left for this turn. I didn't get any page content back.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. So I haven't written any verse notes, because doing it from memory would break those rules. That includes the hard verses (vv. 25–26 on the "statutes that were not good," vv. 35–38 on the rod and the covenant, v. 40 on the holy mountain, and vv. 45–49 on the fire in the Negev).

If you ask me again in a new message, my tool limit should reset and I'll start with:

1. **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word on Ezekiel 20, the Bible Hub commentary pages for each verse from 20:25 to 20:49, Precept Austin's Ezekiel 20 page, and StudyLight for anything missing.
2. **Differences between Protestant traditions:** searches on Ligonier, Monergism, The Gospel Coalition, Desiring God, GTY, Wesley Center (wesley.nnu.edu), Seedbed, LCMS and 1517. I'd focus on vv. 25–26, 33–38 and 40–44, where views on judgment, the remnant and Israel's future tend to split.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes (netbible.org), Bible Odyssey, New Advent (for the Church Fathers and the Catholic Encyclopedia), Catholic.com and OCA.org.

Each point would come with its URL, and I'd leave out anything I can't find on the pages.
